label: Oven wire rack
test_scope: Offline synthetic tests. Forces and mass are engineering assumptions, not hardware measurements.

physics_properties.mass_justification: Circular rod-volume budget: 17 x 0.494 m x pi x (0.0023 m)^2 plus 2.316 m x pi x (0.004 m)^2 plus 1.32 m x pi x (0.0028 m)^2, times 7850 kg/m3, is 2.27 kg; about 0.02 kg is shared at welded overlaps. Use 2.25 kg. Actual product weight and wire diameters remain unmeasured.
physics_properties.density_scope: steel constituent; do not multiply outer bounding volume
physics_properties.friction_status: assumed dry contact; stainless 0.3-0.4; cloth/counterface requires calibration

source_joints.name: oven_wire_rack_slide
source_joints.status: Level outward slide in rack frame. Contact-guided removable rack; 0.38 m travel and stop are unobserved. Open oven before extending.

provenance.geometry: Reconstructed from kitchen video; hidden surfaces are completed. Scale and material appearance remain approximate.
provenance.motion: Observed trajectories where documented; unobserved axes and endpoints are assumptions.
provenance.forces: Simulation measurements of assumed parameters; not force measurements from video.

visual_bindings_note: Visuals use the latest asset revision; mechanism geometry may predate it. Body rest offsets preserve the visual placement.
